name: B10-0054/2024 (S&D) – The severe situation of political prisoners in Belarus
title: Resolution on the severe situation of political prisoners in Belarus
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Belarus to release all political prisoners and people held without reason. It says around 1,350 political prisoners remain, and many detainees have been mistreated. It asks the European Union and its member states to help prisoners and their families, and to press Belarus for proof of where prisoners are and how they are. It also warns that Belarus misuses international arrest warrants to catch opponents abroad, and asks Serbia not to hand over journalist Andrei Gnyot.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and request, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Belarus's government, political prisoners and their families, and Serbia.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU institutions, Serbia and others. Follow-up depends on them.
